caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a handled item resembling a skimmer or strainer, and a separate round ornamental detail shown at the top right. The main object has a long, turned wooden handle in brown shades, with the wood grain visible and some decorative knobs along its length. Attached to the handle is a round, flat, perforated metal disk, which is rendered in gold and bronze tones, with several evenly spaced holes around its surface. The ornamentation at the top right is a circular medallion or disk, also colored in gold and featuring decorative patterns, including a central circular motif and swirling designs with blue dots around the perimeter. The drawing is set within a simple rectangular border, and the background is plain and light in color. The artist's signature "Karl Gonbert" appears in the lower right corner of the image, outside the rectangular border.
title: Warming Pan
